title: Wizardry
description: a magic datapack that adds new content to your world!!
body:
¡Resource Pack Required!

Resource Pack Link: [Wizardry Resources](https://modrinth.com/project/wizardry-resources)

¡Multiplayer Compatibility!

This datapack adds new content to your world!
- 9 New Structures ( some of these with interesting variants
- 17 New Items
- 8 New Tools
- 4 New Blocks
- 25 New Advancements
Around the world there will be structures that you will need to progress with the magic!

If you have problems progressing, you can craft the datapack guide book that will help you with your journey
The guide book is made by throwing Magic Dust on top of a Bookshelf.
The guide book will teach you everything about this datapack

Adds a new and simple custom casting system

The next updates will only be bug fixs or very small things

P.S: The trees seen in the world generation do not come with the datapack

Other data packs used:
- [Alloy's Details of Flora](https://modrinth.com/datapack/alloys-details-of-flora)
